files_changed.summary: Plan doc for the export mount.
Every note on the session's highlights (g1).
Maps rows + PDF bytes -> BundleInput, appends, zips, downloads (g2).
The header control, disabled with a reason (g4).
3 tests: full map+call, slug-less skipped, nothing-to-export.
Mounts the Export control in the header (g4).

decisions: The bbox rect list is re-read locally in the export hook because its owner (features/highlight's isBbox) may not be imported by features/workspace (I3); only the rects are needed, and the parser is written to reject anything malformed. Recorded as a small, deliberate duplication.
A highlight with no slug is skipped: the slug is the bundle's only identity anchor (RULE-25), so a slug-less row cannot be exported without breaking the round trip.
The bundle format is 016's shared/lib/bundle.ts, called unchanged; 027 adds no second format and never re-renders a page (appendHighlightsToPdf appends to the original bytes).
The export reads profileId/sessionId from the shared workspace context (026), so the feature imports no other feature and the control can live in the header.
If there is no main PDF artifact the control is disabled with a reason ('Open a workspace with a document to export'); a failure during export surfaces in the control's title rather than throwing.
The filename slug is a plain slugify of the session title (falling back to the session id); the spec does not define a distinct workspace slug.
